name: description-list
title: Description List
description: Terms and their details in a dl: stacked, inline (side by side, stacked again in a narrow container) or a grid of columns. Spacing from the role tokens, copyable details with an agent copy action, and a dash for an empty value that screen readers read as an overridable label.
docs: `<DescriptionList layout columns labels>` renders a `dl` of `DescriptionItem`s, each a `div` holding a `DescriptionTerm` (`dt`) and its `DescriptionDetails` (`dd`). `layout="stacked"` (default) puts each term above its details, `gap-group` between items; `"inline"` puts them side by side, the term at `--description-term-width` (33%), divided by rules, and stacks them again once the list's own width drops under 24rem (a container query, so it works in a side panel); `"grid"` lays the items out in as many columns as fit at `--description-column-min` (12rem), never more than `columns` (3). Spacing comes from the role tokens, so `data-theme="compact"` tightens it. An empty `DescriptionDetails` (nothing, `null` or `""`) shows an `aria-hidden` dash and reads `labels.empty` ("Not set"). `mono` sets the value in the monospace face (ids, hashes). `copyable` adds a copy button after the value (`copyValue` when the details aren't plain text, `onCopy`), as CodeBlock does: the value is a group named by its term with a `copy` action for agents, the button is hidden from them, and "Copied" (`labels.copied`) is announced. Override `labels={{ empty, copy, copied }}` in the page's language.
